items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: there was another band in there named Jack Allen. I didn't play with them, my brother was with that band.

ctx.x: No. Not everybody could in those days. And how many years roughly were you in Kansas City?
'27,'28, and then I joined the Benny Moten band, I think, in '29. And I was in and out for about four years, I think, till '34, I believe, or '33.
Well, you had a good experience of it, anyway.
